eval_dimensions.name: Standalone Fixup Confirmation Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When no comment ID or PR comment URL is provided and the invocation args do not carry an explicit target-commit + description, the skill fires AskUserQuestion to confirm a standalone fixup before creating any commit.

evals.name: Standalone gate fires with no comment and no explicit target
evals.description: Invocation with neither pr_number/comment_id nor an explicit target commit SHA + description fires AskUserQuestion before any git operation beyond the CWD check.
evals.input: /dev10x:git-fixup (no comment ID, no PR, no explicit target commit)

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with options 'Yes, standalone fixup' / 'No, use /dev10x:git-commit instead'
No inline 'Create a standalone fixup?' text substitutes for the tool call
No fixup! commit is created before AskUserQuestion returns a response

evals.name: Explicit target commit + description skips the gate
evals.description: When the invocation args include a target commit SHA and description, intent is clear and the skill proceeds directly to standalone fixup mode without asking.
evals.input: /dev10x:git-fixup abc1234 Fix null handling in phone lookup

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called; the skill proceeds directly to standalone fixup mode

evals.name: Review fixup mode (comment ID / PR comment URL) skips the gate
evals.description: When a comment ID or PR comment URL is provided, the skill enters review fixup mode and never fires the standalone-confirm gate.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called; the skill fetches comment details (Step 2) instead

evals.name: Declining the gate suggests dev10x:git-commit instead of falling through
evals.description: When the user declines the standalone-fixup confirmation, the skill suggests dev10x:git-commit and does not create a fixup! commit.
evals.input: /dev10x:git-fixup (no comment ID, no PR) → user selects 'No, use /dev10x:git-commit instead'

assertions.signal: No git commit call runs; the response points to Skill(dev10x:git-commit)

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the git-fixup skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to create a fixup! commit

should_trigger.query: create a fixup for this review comment
should_trigger.rationale: Review-fixup intent tied to a PR comment

should_not_trigger.query: create a regular commit for these changes
implement the fix, push, and reply to the review comment
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use dev10x:gh-pr-fixup, which wraps push + reply
